title: Founder Scholarship (Fall 2026 Policy)
content: Under the Fall 2026 Scholarship Policy, eligible students who achieved GPA 5.00 in both SSC and HSC (subject to passing-year limits and official policy terms) qualify for the Founder Scholarship. Note: Tuition scholarships are subject to the official scholarship cap of up to 60% under current policy conditions and apply to tuition fees only (not admission/registration/non-tuition fees). Final scholarship approval is determined solely by the Admission Office upon verifying original transcripts.

title: Merit-Based Tuition Fee Scholarships (Fall 2026)
content: Uttara University awards merit-based tuition waivers based on SSC and HSC (or equivalent) GPA results, as well as semester-by-semester academic performance (CGPA) for continuing students. Program-specific scholarship offers may also apply depending on the department and intake. All waivers are subject to passing-year eligibility, minimum credit load, and disciplinary standing.

title: Additional 5% Scholarship for Eligible Female Students
content: Eligible female students receive an additional 5% tuition scholarship on top of qualifying merit waivers, subject to the overall 60% maximum scholarship cap and Fall 2026 policy terms.

title: Scholarship Maximum Cap (60%)
content: Under the Fall 2026 Scholarship Policy, combined scholarships/waivers are subject to a maximum cap of 60% of tuition fees, unless an explicit exception is authorized under official university policy. Calculator results in this assistant are preliminary estimates only—not an official scholarship approval.
